scope: Renewed current source follow-up for the remaining nine exact eligible national chamber identities in eight Africa/Balkans country groups. This is first follow-up coverage, not complete service/rights validation.

method.sources: Published official institutional routes, own institutional designated media, direct ordinary GET, official web text and normal Chromium rendering. Historical catalogue notes supply leads only.
method.distinctions: House/Council coverage is separate. Source designation, dated document/media labels, loaded player frames and decoded playback are distinct. Access errors do not imply absence; no rights inferred from visibility.
method.browser_environment: Browser plugin unavailable; installed Playwright 1.64.0 Chromium, 1440 x 1000. No fresh native media found on selected loaded wrappers. Only explicitly listed screenshot inspected for visual finding.
method.safety: No outreach, CAPTCHA interaction, TLS/authentication bypass, private API, media download or provider manifest extraction. Published public Atom feed and document text only; no raw HTML or credentials saved in repo.

strong_findings: Mauritius published recent-event feed is live Atom, 25 entries; first event matches own dated 20 October archive and carries +04:00. Future 27 October guide is separate; player rendered blank and event type is ambiguous.
Ghana current resumption banner versus stale Agenda index, Namibia Assembly current Order Paper versus old Schedule nav, and Council calendar through February are documented independently.
Official source designation renewed for Botswana, Cabo Verde, Ghana, Montenegro, North Macedonia and Namibia; no provider visibility converted to reuse permission.
